pages.text: The best choice, and the shape of a network.

$(thing)Optimisation$(): the $(item)Optimiser$() walks downhill on a bowl. Set the step and the number of steps: each step multiplies the distance from the bottom by |1 − hλ|, and what is left after n steps must be under the recipe's tolerance. Too short a step crawls; too long overshoots, and past hλ = 2 it runs away. A step of exactly 1/λ lands at once, and the fewer steps, the faster. It makes the $(item)Optimised Pathway$() upgrade (a quarter less power per run) and, with $(thing)Topology Optimisation$(), Metamaterial Sheets from quartz, Quantum Dots and Rational Fields. Its calibration: find the shortest route.

$(thing)Graph Theory$(): the $(item)Graph Loom$() weaves networks. Set the junctions and the links: V − 1 links make a tree, and each one more is a spare route. The network fails only if all of its routes fail at once, and that must be rarer than the recipe allows. It makes $(item)Network Maps$() ($(thing)Networks$()) and, with $(thing)Shortest Paths$(), routes Photonic Processors with fewer dies and no qubits. Its calibration: lay the lightest network that joins every junction.
Both machines are built with Euclidean Shards, from the Elements.
